turns.instruction:
Build and analyze the attached sloped-roof frame in YJK. Low roof edge Y=0 is Z=6 m; high edge Y=5 is Z=8 m. The front middle column at X=6,Y=0 is absent; its roof joint connects both neighboring X beams and its sloped Y beam. Apply global -Z 5 kN/m to each of the three sloped Y beams per actual member length. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at n2-1-1 (12,5,roof-high-Z) m, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at n0-0-0 (0,0,0) m, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated YJK engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Raise only the high roof edge at Y=5 from Z=8 m to Z=9 m. Keep the low edge at 6 m and keep the front middle column absent. All connected member endpoints follow their shared roof joints. Keep the original global downward line intensity 5 kN/m per actual sloped length, then reanalyze. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at n2-1-1 (12,5,roof-high-Z) m, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at n0-0-0 (0,0,0) m, for every listed case and combination.
